pages.text:
A treated-wood bin that turns plant matter into Compost. Seeds, crops, leaves, saplings, flowers and food scraps go in, each with the same chance as in a vanilla composter of raising the heap a level.
- Right-click with plant matter to drop it straight in.
- Hoppers and conduits fill its input slot, which it works through one item every half second.
- Two seconds after it's full, it makes Compost. Right-click it to take the Compost, or pull it out from underneath with a hopper or conduit; then it starts again.
